title_zh: 确定双人组合录音的补录与标注安排

scenario.label_zh: 确定双人组合录音的修正方式
scenario.goal_zh: 指出人声回声问题，并约定补录人声且将成品标为录音室版本

context_zh: 一个原声双人组合的成员与录音师检查为宣传制作的录音。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: The guitar has our duo's distinctive sound, but my voice seems to repeat behind itself.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: That is an echo from the room. We can reduce it, but the vocal track may still sound muddy.

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: Could we dub a new vocal over the guitar track?

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Yes, if you can match the timing. We should not describe the result as an unedited live performance.

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: Agreed. It is for a studio promo, not a concert record.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Then let us record the vocal again and label the finished track as the studio version.

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: Fine. I will keep the original tempo and leave the guitar as it is.

targets.sense_zh: 为已有录音配录新的声音
